# Introduction

We investigate the performance of PoSIRd confidence regions for refining an overestimated segmentation of a two-dimensional piecewise-constant signal.

Data are generated with a fixed number of true changepoints and correlated Gaussian noise. We first estimate a segmentation using dynamic programming with a potentially overestimated number of changepoints, $K_{high}$. After enforcing the minimum segment-length constraint, we prune the segmentation by removing changepoints separating segments whose PoSIRd confidence regions overlap.

We evaluate the procedure across different values of $K_{high}$ and signal amplitudes, comparing the initial, filtered, and pruned segmentations in terms of:

- Changepoint recovery: number of detected changepoints, false discovery proportion and Hausdorff distance.
- Simultaneous coverage: empirical coverage of the average true signal over all valid estimated segments, exploiting the uniform validity of PoSIRd confidence regions.
- Region precision: average confidence-region area.

The objective is to assess whether PoSIRd-based pruning can effectively remove spurious changepoints while preserving genuine changes and maintaining valid, informative confidence regions.

# Common setup

## Load the PoSIRd code and quantile table

```{r load-posird}
library(posir)
library(jointseg)
source(here::here("inst", "scripts", "posird", "utils_competitors.R"))

Qtable <- posir:::read_quantiles(
  here::here("Simulations", "Table_quantiles.txt")
)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(purrr)
library(knitr)

```

# Simulation settings

```{r}
config <- list(
  B = 1000,
  n = 1000,
  n_chg = 10,
  K_high = 25,
  delta = 0.005,
  alpha = 0.1, # to better see possible error
  epsilon = 0.5,
  amplitude = 1,
  rho = 0.7,
  seed = 1036,
  workers = max(1, min(8, future::availableCores() - 1))
)

Sigma <- matrix(
  c(1, config$rho, config$rho, 1),
  nrow = 2,
  byrow = TRUE
)
```


# One simulation

```{r}
# Generate data
set.seed(1033)
cgp <- generate_changepoints(n = config$n, n_chg = config$n_chg,
                             delta = config$delta)$changepoints

data <- generate_piecewise_normal_2d(n = config$n,
                                     changepoints = cgp,
                                     Sigma = Sigma,
                                     possible_states = c(-config$amplitude,
                                                         0,
                                                         config$amplitude))
x <- data$x

# Estimate segmentation with high K
config$n*config$delta
seg <- doDynamicProgramming(x, K = config$K_high)$bkp
mean(cgp %in% seg)

# Remove changepoints that are too close to the previous one
ndelta <- ceiling(config$n * config$delta)
seg <- seg[c(TRUE, diff(seg) >= ndelta)] #arbitrary, probabbly not a great idea

# Get posird regions
posird <- confidence_regions_1D(x = x,
                                breakpoints = seg,
                                delta = config$delta,
                                alpha = config$alpha,
                                Qtable = Qtable,
                                covariance_method = "diff_mom_entrywise",
                                covariance_blocks = 50)
cbind(posird$lengths, posird$valid)

mu1_grid <- seq(range(x[,1])[1], range(x[,1])[2], length.out = 400)
mu2_grid <- seq(range(x[,2])[1], range(x[,2])[2], length.out = 400)
plot(posird,
     mu1_grid = mu1_grid,
     mu2_grid = mu2_grid,
     show_centers = F)

par(mfrow = c(2, 1), mar = c(4, 4, 2, 1))
plot_posir1DCR_component(
  posird,
  component = 1,
  box = TRUE
)

plot_posir1DCR_component(
  posird,
  component = 2,
  box = TRUE
)

# Prune overlapping regions
bp_new <- prune_breakpoints_from_posir(posird)
bp_new
cgp

posird_pruned <- confidence_regions_1D(x = x,
                                breakpoints = bp_new[-1],
                                delta = config$delta,
                                alpha = config$alpha,
                                Qtable = Qtable,
                                covariance_method = "diff_mom_entrywise",
                                covariance_blocks = 50)

plot(posird_pruned,
     mu1_grid = mu1_grid,
     mu2_grid = mu2_grid,
     show_centers = F)

par(mfrow = c(2, 1), mar = c(4, 4, 2, 1))
plot_posir1DCR_component(
  posird_pruned,
  component = 1,
  box = TRUE
)

plot_posir1DCR_component(
  posird_pruned,
  component = 2,
  box = TRUE
)

#Check regions validity
```

# MC evaluation

```{r}
K_values <- unique(c(
  config$n_chg,
  config$n_chg + 2,
  2 * config$n_chg,
  3 * config$n_chg
))

amplitude_values <- c(0.5, 1, 2, 3)

n_rep <- 500
ndelta <- ceiling(config$n * config$delta)

simulation_grid <- expand.grid(
  amplitude = amplitude_values,
  K_high = K_values
)

```


```{r simulation-helpers}

filter_changepoints <- function(bkp, n, ndelta) {
  bkp <- sort(unique(as.integer(bkp)))
  bkp <- bkp[bkp > 0 & bkp < n]

  retained <- integer(0)
  previous <- 0L

  for (b in bkp) {
    if (b - previous >= ndelta && n - b >= ndelta) {
      retained <- c(retained, b)
      previous <- b
    }
  }

  retained
}

# One-to-one matching, maximizing the number of matches
# within the tolerance.
cp_metrics <- function(estimated, truth, tolerance) {

  estimated <- sort(unique(estimated))
  truth <- sort(unique(truth))

  n_est <- length(estimated)
  n_true <- length(truth)

  # Dynamic programming for maximum cardinality matching
  matches <- matrix(
    0L, nrow = n_est + 1L, ncol = n_true + 1L
  )

  if (n_est > 0 && n_true > 0) {
    for (i in seq_len(n_est)) {
      for (j in seq_len(n_true)) {
        matches[i + 1L, j + 1L] <- max(
          matches[i, j + 1L],
          matches[i + 1L, j],
          matches[i, j] +
            as.integer(abs(estimated[i] - truth[j]) <= tolerance)
        )
      }
    }
  }

  tp <- matches[n_est + 1L, n_true + 1L]
  fp <- n_est - tp

  nearest_est <- if (n_est > 0 && n_true > 0) {
    vapply(estimated, function(b) min(abs(b - truth)), numeric(1))
  } else {
    numeric(0)
  }

  hausdorff <- if (n_est == 0 && n_true == 0) {
    0
  } else if (n_est == 0 || n_true == 0) {
    NA_real_
  } else {
    max(
      max(nearest_est),
      max(vapply(truth, function(b) min(abs(b - estimated)),
                 numeric(1)))
    )
  }

  data.frame(
    n_est = n_est,
    FDP = fp / max(n_est, 1),
    recall = if (n_true > 0) tp / n_true else NA_real_,
    hausdorff = hausdorff
  )
}

# Coverage and area for a given segmentation
region_metrics <- function(regions, true_signal) {

  targets <- get_true_targets(
    true_signal,
    regions$breakpoints
  )

  covered <- segment_coverage(regions, targets)
  valid <- regions$valid
  areas <- confidence_region_areas(regions)

  data.frame(
    simultaneous_coverage = if (any(valid)) {
      as.numeric(all(covered[valid]))
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    mean_area = if (any(valid)) {
      mean(areas[valid])
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    n_valid = sum(valid),
    proportion_valid = mean(valid)
  )
}

# Create PoSIRd regions
get_regions <- function(x, breakpoints) {
  confidence_regions_1D(
    x = x,
    breakpoints = breakpoints,
    delta = config$delta,
    alpha = config$alpha,
    Qtable = Qtable,
    covariance_method = "diff_mom_entrywise",
    covariance_blocks = 50
  )
}

```


Run simulations

```{r run-simulations, cache=TRUE, warning=FALSE}
set.seed(1139)

results <- list()
counter <- 1L

for (amplitude in amplitude_values) {

  for (rep in seq_len(n_rep)) {

    # Generate true changepoints
    cgp <- generate_changepoints(
      n = config$n,
      n_chg = config$n_chg,
      delta = config$delta
    )$changepoints

    # Generate data
    data <- generate_piecewise_normal_2d(
      n = config$n,
      changepoints = cgp,
      Sigma = Sigma,
      possible_states = c(-amplitude, 0, amplitude)
    )

    x <- data$x

    true_signal <- make_true_signal(
      n = config$n,
      changepoints = cgp,
      segment_means = data$means
    )

    for (K_high in K_values) {

      # Initial segmentation
      seg_initial <- doDynamicProgramming(
        x, K = K_high
      )$bkp

      # Filter minimum segment lengths
      seg_filtered <- filter_changepoints(
        seg_initial,
        n = config$n,
        ndelta = ndelta
      )

      # PoSIRd regions before pruning
      posird <- get_regions(x, seg_filtered)

      # Prune overlapping regions
      bp_new <- prune_breakpoints_from_posir(posird)
      seg_pruned <- bp_new[-1]

      # PoSIRd regions after pruning
      posird_pruned <- get_regions(x, seg_pruned)

      # Evaluate each segmentation
      segmentations <- list(
        Initial = seg_initial,
        Filtered = seg_filtered,
        Pruned = seg_pruned
      )

      regions <- list(
        Initial = NULL,
        Filtered = posird,
        Pruned = posird_pruned
      )

      for (method in names(segmentations)) {

        cp <- cp_metrics(
          estimated = segmentations[[method]],
          truth = cgp,
          tolerance = ndelta / 2
        )

        # Initial segmentation can have invalid short intervals.
        # Evaluate its regions as well.
        if (method == "Initial") {
          regions[[method]] <- get_regions(x, seg_initial)
        }

        cr <- region_metrics(
          regions[[method]],
          true_signal
        )

        results[[counter]] <- data.frame(
          replication = rep,
          amplitude = amplitude,
          K_high = K_high,
          method = method,
          cp,
          cr
        )

        counter <- counter + 1L
      }
    }
  }

  message("Completed amplitude = ", amplitude)
}

results <- bind_rows(results)

saveRDS(results, "simulation_pruning_results.rds")
```

```{r simulation-summary}
results <- simulation_pruning_results
summary_results <- results |>
  group_by(amplitude, K_high, method) |>
  summarise(
    mean_K = mean(n_est),
    mean_FDP = mean(FDP, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_recall = mean(recall, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_hausdorff = mean(hausdorff, na.rm = TRUE),
    coverage = mean(simultaneous_coverage, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_area = mean(mean_area, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_valid = mean(proportion_valid, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

kable(summary_results, digits = 3)
```

Segmentation quality plots

```{r plot-cp-recovery, fig.width=11, fig.height=7}
cp_plot_data <- summary_results |>
  select(amplitude, K_high, method, mean_FDP, mean_recall) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(mean_FDP, mean_recall),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  )

ggplot(cp_plot_data,
       aes(x = K_high, y = value,
           color = method, group = method)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_grid(metric ~ amplitude,
             labeller = label_both,
             scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    x = "K_high",
    y = NULL,
    color = "Segmentation"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```


Simultaneous coverage plots

```{r plot-coverage, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}

    y = "Empirical simultaneous coverage",
    color = "Segmentation"
  ) +
```


```{r}
summary_results <- results |>
  filter(method %in% c("Initial", "Pruned")) |>
  group_by(amplitude, K_high, method) |>
  summarise(
    mean_K = mean(n_est),
    mean_FDP = mean(FDP, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_recall = mean(recall, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_hausdorff = mean(hausdorff, na.rm = TRUE),
    coverage = mean(simultaneous_coverage, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_area = mean(mean_area, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_valid = mean(proportion_valid, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(precision = 1 - mean_FDP)

ggplot(summary_results,
       aes(x = precision, y = mean_recall,
           color = method, group = method)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = factor(K_high)), size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~ amplitude, labeller = label_both) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Precision (1 - FDP)",
    y = "Recall",
    color = "Segmentation",
    shape = "Initial # of changepoints"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

ggplot(summary_results,
       aes(x = K_high, y = coverage,
           color = method, group = method)) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 1 - config$alpha,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ amplitude, labeller = label_both) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.75, 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Initial # of changepoints",
    y = "Empirical simultaneous coverage",
    color = "Segmentation"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

plot_data <- summary_results |>
  mutate(
    FDP = mean_FDP,
    FNR = 1 - mean_recall,
    method = factor(method,
                    levels = c("Initial", "Pruned"),
                    labels = c("Initial", "Pruned"))
  ) |>
  select(amplitude, K_high, method, FDP, FNR) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(FDP, FNR),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  )

ggplot(plot_data,
       aes(x = K_high, y = value,
           color = method, group = method)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  facet_grid(
    metric ~ amplitude,
    labeller = label_both,
    scales = "free_y"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = sort(unique(plot_data$K_high))
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Initial" = "#F8766D",
               "Pruned" = "#00BFC4")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Initial # of changepoints",
    y = NULL,
    color = "Segmentation"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95")
  )
```

```{r}
plot_data <- summary_results |>
  mutate(
    FNR = 1 - mean_recall,
```
